hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(`[:space:]])git([[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+(commit|push|merge|rebase|reset|revert|cherry-pick|tag|stash|checkout|restore|clean|am|apply)\b' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git は参照系のみ実行可。更新系はユーザーが実行する"}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(`[:space:]])python[0-9.]*([[:space:]]|$)' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"python の実行は禁止。ファイル操作は Edit / Write ツールを使う"}}' || true
